briefdescription.para: Server Module — Contract Hardening focused regression tests.

detaileddescription.para: Covers the normative contracts defined in include/server/server_api_contract.h across four acceptance-criteria tracks:

listitem.para: SCH-01..04 — Auth gate enforcement (JWT valid/invalid, missing token → 401)
SCH-05..08 — Retry semantics (backoff budget, idempotency, max-retry exhaustion)
SCH-09..12 — Timeout contract (handler timeout → drain, graceful shutdown ordering)
SCH-13..16 — Rate limit state (per-client limit, distributed fallback fail-closed)
SCH-17..20 — Protocol contract (malformed frame, version mismatch, quorum loss)

detaileddescription.para: All infrastructure is fully in-process; no real TCP ports are opened. Deterministic test data is seeded with kServerContractSeed = 42.
